crown_and_nape_macro_patterns.nape_patch_geometry: A series of high-contrast, horizontal white bands forming a rectangular block on the posterior neck and crown area.
crown_and_nape_macro_patterns.crown_to_mantle_demarcation: A distinct, linear boundary between the patterned white-spotted nape and the solid dark gray/black mantle.

other_distinctive_markers: Pronounced white horizontal spotting/barring extending from the crown down through the nape region.
